title: Timing differences
text: Outstanding bank timing differences may be recorded below 1000 USD after source confirmation.

title: Duplicate payments
text: A duplicate invoice paid twice may be reversed only after invoice and amount confirmation.

title: Duplicate payment detail
text: duplicate invoice paid twice reversal evidence

title: Source support
text: Missing or conflicting source evidence requires abstention and review. Unsupported accruals must not be posted.

title: Vendor identity
text: Ambiguous vendor identity requires independent vendor confirmation.

title: Prior period corrections
text: Prior period accounting errors require controller review and may not be automatically posted.

title: Policy version transitions
text: A changed policy version requires effective-date validation before action.

title: Materiality threshold
text: Items above 1000 USD are material and require controller approval.

title: Suspicious transactions
text: Suspicious unresolved payments require fraud escalation and no ledger action.
